tei:div.tei:p: par thengs gnyis pa'i dpe skrun gsal bshad/

rgyal ba kun gyi snying rje'i rang gzugs 'phags mchog phyan na pad+mo'i thugs rje'i grib bsil/ klu sgrub gnyis pa skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi rgyal tshab/ 'o skol rnams la bka' drin sgo kun nas mtshungs pa med pa'i 'dren mchog 'bri gung 7skyabs mgon nyi zla zung gi thugs bskyed phrin las kyi 'jug pa dus su babs pa'i skabs 7skyabs mgon dkon mchog bstan 'dzin kun bzang phrin las lhun grub dpal bzang po mchog gong ma rim byon gyi mdzad pa thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pa las lhag pa'i sku ngal brgya phrag du ma lhur bzhes mdzad de lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che bshad dang sgrub pa'i sgo nas/ nyams pa slar gso/ mi nyams rgyud 'dzin gnang ba'i bstan 'gro'i mdzad pa grangs las 'das pa'i nang tshan gal che ba bod kyi rig gzhung spyi dang*/ bye brag 'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi phyag dpe rnams dus 'gyur mi zad pa rim byung gis dpe rgyun ches cher dkon pa'i skabs 'dir/ mgon po gang gis 'dzam gling shar nub yul gru kun nas ma dpe 'tshol zhib gnang dang gnang bzhin pa'i thugs rje'i bka' drin la brten 'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi gsung rab mang dag cig da cha rig mdzod 'phrul par thog gsar du par skrun thub pa byung ba'i nang tshan skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon bka' 'bum gyi phyi'i bka' 'bum pod (ka nas cha)bar dang*/ nang gi zab chos pod (ja nas/ ta)bar pod gsum/ bka' 'bum kha skong pod (tha nas/ na)bar bcas bka' 'bum pod bcu gnyis par thengs dang po spyi lo 2000 lor par skrun cha tshang zin yang*/ pod na)pa pod tshad ma lon pa da lan par thengs gnyis pa'i skabs chos tshan zhal skong zhus pa gsham gsal/ 'jig rten mgon po'i zab chos rnal 'byor bzhi ldan/ thabs lam gsal ba'i sgron me/ dpal ye shes mgon po'i bstod pa/ bde mchog dril bu'i ri gnas bshad/

lnga ldan shog khra ma'i rgyab chos/ rje'i tshig gsum gnad kyi gdams pa/ sku gshegs kha'i zhal chems dbon shes rab 'byung gnas kyis yi ger btab pa/ sku gshegs khar nye gnas rnams kyis sgrub pa byed pa'i dam bca' phul ba la gsungs pa/ 'chi ba blu ba/ gtum mo'i lo rgyus/ smon lam bsdus pa/ yi ge 'bri tshul tsheg phrad ji bzhin dgos par gdams pa/ a phyi'i bskang ba bka' rgya ma bcas zhal skong zhus yod/ da lan par thengs gnyis pa'i skabs bskyar du zhus dag thengs gnyis dang*/ gsang ba'i zab chos pod gnyis ma dpe ma 'dra ba bcu tsam phan tshun go bsdur gyis zhus dag byas yod/ de sngon par thengs gnyis pa'i skabs par skrun ma zhus pa shin tu bka' rgya che ba'i gsang ba'i zab chos pod gnyis da lan thengs gcig par skrun ma zhus tshe slad ma phyi rig mdzod nang nas brlag gtor shor nyen che bas/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi'i nyams len legs par grub pa'i sgrub grwa rnam pa'i ched tshar grangs brgya tham pa par skrun zhus yod/ thengs 'di'i par skrun skabs pod ka)nas/ ga)bar gyi dbu lha rnams zab mo lta brgyud dang*/ nga) nas/ cha)bar rgya chen spyod brgyud/ ja)bka' babs dang po/ nya)bka' babs gnyis pa/ ta)bka' babs gsum pa/ tha)bka' babs bzhi pa/ da)nas/ pha)bar rtogs pa byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa bcas cung zad bsdus te bkod pa yin/ dbu lha'i ri mo phal che ba gzhis rtse kha rag lha bris bu chung lags nas bris gnang mdzad pa dang*/ lo tsā ba kro nis lags nas bod yig Program TibetDoc rim pa gsar shos dang*/ tshig mdzod 'dra min bcas lhag bsam chen pos rin med zhal 'debs gnang ba bcas thengs 'di'i 7skyob pa'i bka' 'bum par thengs gnyis pa legs grub kyi mthun 'gyur mkhan rnams la thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ ldi li 'bri gung bka' brgyud gsung rab nyams gso khang las 'go tshugs nas lo lnga'i ring gsung rab par skrun zhus pa'i dkar chag rob bsdus tsam ni/

7skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi bka' 'bum pod 14/ spyan snga rnam gnyis kyi gsung 'bum pod 2/ rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi gsung 'bum pod 6/ bde mchog chos skor pod 1/ gshin rje'i chos skor pod 1/ dgongs gcig rin byang ma pod 1/ theg chen bstan snying 'grel chen pod 2/ dgongs gcig 'grel chen pod 2/ 'od zer skor gsum pod 4/ dgyes rdor mgar 'grel pod 1/ nyams len phyogs sgrig pod 1/ bcas ldeb grangs sum brgya lhag can gyi pod 35 tsam dang*/ nyer mkho'i chos tshan 'ga' zhig bcas gsar du rig mdzod du par rtsa gsar 'jug dang*/ zhus dag dpe sgrig bcas sgrub dpon bsod nams 'byor 'phel rin po che dang*/ sku zhabasarin chen phun tshogs gnyis kyis mthun 'gyur bdag rkyen 'og gong zhus phyag dpe khag tshang ma tshar grangs lnga brgya re las mi nyung ba par skrun zhus te rang khongs 'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi dgon khag rnams la rten 'jog du phul yod/ las khungs dus yun lo lnga'i nang mkhan po rig 'dzin dbang rgyal lo gcig mgon po rdo rje lo gnyis/ dkon mchog tshul khrims lo gcig dang phyed ka bcas dang*/ lo lnga cha tshang mtha' 'khyol las byed yo rad brtson 'grus seṅge*/ ye shes rgya mtsho/ karma 'gyur med/ dkon mchog don grub/ gus skal bzang chos 'phel bcas tshang mas phyar gru mnyam 'degs kyis so so'i rang 'khri'i las 'gan gang yod ci thub zhabs tog zhus pa bcas 'bri gung bka' brgyud gsung rab nyams gso khang nas//
